scope.description: Test Audit governance improvements: time-seam guards, slow governance scan caching, duplicate-name consolidation, and compatibility sunset ledger.
scope.strategy: Extend replay time-seam detection, reuse deterministic architecture scan snapshots, consolidate duplicate test-name inventory artifacts, and add sunset ledger for compatibility behavior tests.

5974.title: [Test Audit] P1 Extend replay time-seam guards beyond time.time and datetime.now
actions_taken: Extended time_seam_classification.yaml with new seams: time.time_ns (checkpoint IO), datetime.now (memory tooling)
Updated test_replay_time_seam_inventory.py to detect time.time_ns and datetime.utcnow
All time seams now classified with operator_time_allowed category for non-replay-critical paths

5975.title: [Test Audit] P1 Reduce slow architecture governance scan hotspots
actions_taken: Added session-scoped import-record snapshots on top of the existing architecture AST cache.
Moved checkpoint runtime facade import guards from per-test ast.walk scans to shared source/test import-record fixtures.
Moved CLI command import guards from repeated git_tracked_files/read_text/ast.parse scans to the shared source import-record fixture.
Memoized config discrepancy baseline payloads, scorecard reads, live metrics, live family metrics, and live parameter taxonomy within the pytest process.
Kept the fast architecture boundary lane separate from the slow governance lane in configs/quality/test_matrix.yaml.

duration_budget.hard_reason: Committed telemetry charges session-scoped AST cache setup to the first tests that request the cache. Shared import-record fixtures remove repeated ast.walk/file-parse work, but the first requesting tests can still carry shared setup time until the next full CI telemetry refresh redistributes zone attribution.

5976.title: [Test Audit] P2 Consolidate duplicate test-name inventory artifacts
actions_taken: Updated report_test_governance_audit.py to remove duplicate-name artifact generation
Updated all configuration files and workflows to reference consolidated artifact

5977.title: [Test Audit] P2 Add sunset ledger for compatibility behavior tests
actions_taken: Created compatibility_sunset_ledger.yaml with sunset policy for compatibility/legacy/deprecated tests
Created test_behavior_retirement_ledger_governance.py for ledger validation (renamed to avoid compatibility pattern match)
Added sunset criteria and required evidence fields

closeout.rationale: All 4 issues completed. Issue #5975 now has shared import-scan caching, memoized config discrepancy live snapshots, lane isolation evidence, and a no-growth duration budget anchored to committed telemetry.
